title: Shopping starts with AI agents, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). HP launched Experience AI; TikTok, Gap and Walmart added AI shopping. Memory costs pressure PC prices.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream path to purchase, and rivals are building for it
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; HP launched Experience AI; TikTok and Gap added AI shopping. We should benchmark our search, content and checkout against these.

points.headline: Anti-bot defenses block shopping agents, a risk for our store
points.detail: TechCrunch reports bot defenses are blocking personal AI shopping agents. We should check that legitimate agents can reach and buy from our store.

points.headline: Memory costs and premium AI laptops reshape PC pricing
points.detail: Suppliers prioritize server DRAM, threatening PC shipments, while Surface Laptop Ultra is priced at $2,599. We need to plan pricing and stock messaging for AI tiers.

points.headline: Amazon pushes into tablets and festive demand while delivery bar rises
points.detail: Amazon launched Alexa-enabled Android tablets and expects 35-40% festive demand growth in India. We should watch its own-tablet ranking and our delivery promises.
